name: World Wonders

categories.label: Population rings reached
categories.hint: 1 VP per Ring your marker reached or passed on the Population track.

categories.label: Lowest of Food / Ceramics / Gear tracks
categories.hint: VP = value of your lowest of the three Resource tracks.

categories.label: Rings on Monument cards
categories.hint: 1 VP per Ring printed on your Monument cards.

categories.label: Natural Resources adjacent to your pieces
categories.labelVi: Tài nguyên tự nhiên kề công trình
categories.hint: 1 VP per visible Natural Resource adjacent to at least one of your placed pieces.

categories.label: City Districts
categories.hint: 1 VP per Building Tile surrounded on all sides by non-green features.

categories.label: Unpaid loans
categories.hint: -2 VP for each loan not repaid by game end.

categories.label: Public Objective cards (advanced)
categories.labelVi: Thẻ mục tiêu công khai (nâng cao)
categories.hint: Advanced play only: VP for 1st/2nd place on each Public Objective (printed rings); tied 1st share sum of 1st+2nd rounded up.

tiebreakers.description: Tie: the player with the most Monuments wins.

notes: family: end-game-categories. Game ends after 10 rounds or at the end of the round where a player reaches the last Population space. Solo Automaton mode (compare against sum of 3 resources, +Automaton Monument VP on hard) not modelled. Public Objective values are printed on cards, hence manual input; set to 0 in the basic game.
